doc.name: limitreceipts-plan-fit
doc.instructions: plan_fit ranks published coding-agent prices. tier=full may require x402 payment. This server never signs or pays.

tools.name: plan_fit
tools.description: Rank coding-agent plans from LimitReceipts. tier=free needs no payment and returns one plan with source_url and verified_date. If audience is omitted, tier=free defaults it to individual and tier=full defaults it to any. tier=full requires x402; this server returns the payment requirements and does not sign or pay.

type.description: Tool kind filter. cli matches cli or both. editor matches editor or both.

audience.description: Optional filter. Omitted on tier=free defaults to individual. Omitted on tier=full defaults to any. Explicit individual, team, or any is honoured on both tiers.

models.description: Optional comma-separated substrings matched against plan models.

tier.description: free returns one plan. full requires x402 payment.

tools.name: plan_fit_info
tools.description: Describe plan-fit query params, tiers, price, networks, facilitators, and whether each network has a receiving wallet configured.
